speaker: Penny
text: I could think about you. Always nice talking to you, Sheldon.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Fine, whatever works. Peace out. Our whole universe was in a hot dense state, and nearly fourteen billion years ago, expansion started. Wait, the earth began to cool, the autotrophs began to drool, Neanderthals developed tools, we built a wall.

speaker: Sheldon
text: We built the pyramids, math, science, history, unraveling the mystery of all.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Well, this is very pleasant. And you said there'd never be enough pasta for the three of us.

speaker: Leonard
text: Glad you're enjoying yourself. I stand corrected.

speaker: Sheldon
text: You know. Italian housewives have a rule of thumb. A handful of dry pasta, about an inch in diameter, is sufficient for each person, as it doubles in volume when cooked.

speaker: Leonard
text: She doesn't mean it. She's just being nice.
